title: EventVL: Understand Event Streams via Multimodal Large Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2501.13707v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The event-based Vision-Language Model (VLM) recently has made good progress for practical vision tasks. However, most of these works just utilize CLIP for focusing on traditional perception tasks, which obstruct model understanding explicitly the sufficient semantics and context from event streams. To address the deficiency, we propose EventVL, the first generative event-based MLLM (Multimodal Large Language Model) framework for explicit semantic understanding. Specifically, to bridge the data gap for connecting different modalities semantics, we first annotate a large event-image/video-text dataset, containing almost 1.4 million high-quality pairs of data, which enables effective learning across various scenes, e.g., drive scene or human motion. translated_title: EventVL：基于多模态大语言模型理解事件流
translated_abstract: 近期，基于事件的视觉语言模型（VLM）在实际视觉任务中取得了良好进展。然而，这些工作大多仅利用CLIP专注于传统感知任务，阻碍了模型对事件流中充分语义和上下文信息的显式理解。为解决这一不足，我们提出了EventVL，这是首个用于显式语义理解的生成式事件多模态大语言模型（MLLM）框架。具体而言，为弥合连接不同模态语义的数据鸿沟，我们首先标注了一个大型事件-图像/视频-文本数据集，包含近140万对高质量数据，能够在多种场景（如驾驶场景或人体运动）中实现有效学习。随后，我们设计了事件时空表示，通过对事件流进行多样化的聚合与分割来充分挖掘全面信息。为进一步提升……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出首个生成式事件多模态大语言模型框架EventVL，通过构建约140万对事件-图像/视频-文本数据集并设计事件时空表示，实现了对事件流的显式语义理解。
